Starlink enables education in remote areas

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-06T09:09:04+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2118631742529769490; média: 1 kép]
Starlink is bringing internet access to remote classrooms in Indonesia

Katingan’s local government is distributing Starlink kits to preschools, elementary schools and junior high schools across areas where traditional internet remains weak or unavailable

In 2026, Katingan received 287 Starlink units in total

Of those, 174 were allocated to education including PAUD, elementary schools, junior high schools and regional education coordinators

For teachers and students, that means access to digital learning materials, online references and school services that were much harder to reach before

A single Starlink connection opens up an entire classroom to the world
